metadata.title: Length distortion of volume-preserving Lipschitz mappings
metadata.abstract: We show that every area-preserving Lipschitz map between metric surfaces distorts the length of almost every curve by at most a multiplicative factor, answering a question posed by the first author and Ntalampekos. We give two different proofs. The first is entirely intrinsic and extends to higher dimensions under additional assumptions. The second relies on non-smooth uniformization theory and yields the conclusion that the family of curves intersecting the purely 2-unrectifiable part of a metric surface in a set of positive length is exceptional.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 证明保面积 Lipschitz 度量曲面映射对几乎所有曲线具有双侧乘法长度控制。
analysis.breakthrough: 回答已有问题，并以两种证明连接保测度条件与长度控制。
analysis.limitations: “几乎所有”是曲线族意义，不是每一条曲线；高维推广需要附加假设。 已补读相关引言或主结果片段，尚未逐行验证完整证明。
analysis.priorityReason: 非光滑曲面与整流性技术与课题组方向高度契合。
